question: What Telegram system-notice suppression boundary should this PR implement, if any, while preserving documented compaction notifyUser and command/status reply delivery?
rationale: The proposed adapter-level filter changes user-visible channel policy and conflicts with current documented delivery behavior, so maintainer intent is needed before choosing the permanent suppression contract.

options.title: Preserve Current Delivery Contract
options.body: Keep compaction notifyUser notices and visible system-marked command/status replies deliverable, and only suppress a narrowly typed unwanted notice class if one is identified.

options.title: Approve Typed Telegram Suppression
options.body: Define explicit payload metadata for the Telegram-only notice class to hide, update tests/docs as needed, and require real Telegram proof.

options.title: Pause Or Close This Direction
options.body: If there is no concrete unwanted notice class or product decision, close or replace this PR with a narrower issue describing the intended Telegram behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve Current Delivery Contract
recommendation.body: Keep compaction notifyUser notices and visible system-marked command/status replies deliverable, and only suppress a narrowly typed unwanted notice class if one is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the related compaction delivery repair and is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for deciding whether this PR may change that channel-delivery contract.
